content.title: G Q3 Deep Dive: Advanced Technology Solutions Fuel Growth, Margin Expansion
content.summary: Business transformation services company Genpact (NYSE:G) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 6.6% year on year to $1.29 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $1.30 billion at the midpoint, 1.2% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.97 per share was 8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
